item.title: CKB Talk Daily Brief - 2026-10-18
item.description: ## 今日发生了什么 过去一天论坛最集中的讨论是 Metaforo 投票快照绑定问题：有用户称自己在 Nervos DAO 存入超过 10 万 CKB、Neuron 地址也已绑定 Metaforo，但投票/点赞活跃提案时仍报错 [S01]。随后有社区成员判断可能是绑定交易选错，或误用了 inputs 而不是 outputs，并表示可提供分步指导 [S02]；提问者回应会私信联系 [S03]。RIVET 提案线程公布投票已通过，批准率 52.82%，总投票权重 244,888,704 CKB，并称已用 CKB DAO Watchdog 完成投票后核验 [S04]。Spark Program 下新增 MatchLock 提案 [S05]，Corven cloud-native IDE 线程则补充了 CKB Kisumu Workshop 2026 的照片和视频材料 [S06]。 ## 重点话题 Metaforo 投票绑定求助：用户有 10 万以上 CKB 在 Nervos DAO，但无法对活跃提案投票/点赞 [S01]；社区初步把原因指向绑定交易或 inputs/outputs 选择问题 [S02]，双方已转私信继续沟通 [S03]。 RIVET 投票结果：线程公布提案以 52.82% 批准率、244,888,704 CKB 总投票权重通过，并称投票后核验已完成 [S04]。 MatchLock 新提案：Spark Program 下出现一个可复用的 CKB lock/type script 库提案，目标是让项目加入 private-until-match/reveal...

item.title: Unable to vote/like active proposal — Nervos DAO snapshot behavior on Metaforo (3 posts)
item.description: Hi everyone, I have a technical question regarding Metaforo voting snapshot rules: I currently have over 100,000 CKB deposited into the Nervos DAO via my Neuron wallet. My Neuron wallet address is bound to my Metaforo account. However, I receive an error when attempting to vote or like the proposal (“At least 100,000 CKB are required to perform this action” / “No Neuron address or the binded address do not have CKB”). Does anyone know the reason why this is happening and how to troubleshoot? Thanks for clarifying! GM chief, I think you might have binded the wrong transaction. item.title: [DIS] RIVET: Decentralized GitHub Backup, Timestamping and Restore on CKB (1 posts)
item.description: Based on the Metaforo tally at close, the outcome is PASSED. Approval is 52.82% with total voting weight 244,888,704 CKB. Post-close verification has been completed using CKB DAO Watchdog (GitHub - CKBFansDAO/ckb-dao-watchdog: Community-driven tools for auditing and verifying CKB DAO governance voting results. · GitHub), together with a manual sanity check. The verification cross-checks Metaforo-recorded voting weights against on-chain Nervos DAO deposit weights. In this run, 21 of 22 entries match. One Yes entry is flagged in the log because the voter’s current on-chain deposit is 300,000 CKB higher than the weight Metaforo recorded. The difference comes from a single new deposit made...

item.description: 1.
